lines.en: Four paws on the plains.

lines.zh: 我身上有三个头的重量。
lines.en: Three heads of weight on me.
I patrol slowly near my anchor.
The grass presses into a path.

lines.zh: 我的爪子落地几乎没有声。
lines.en: My paws land almost silently.

lines.zh: 我从诡异森林边上走过。
lines.en: I pass the edge of the warped wood.
I walk toward a scent.

lines.zh: 鼻息把草吹开，露出泥土。
lines.en: My breath parts the grass and shows the soil.

lines.zh: 我绕着圈，守着自己的范围。
lines.en: I circle, holding my range.
I am larger than a horse.
I breathe in heavy pulls.

lines.zh: 我踏过草原，草伏成一条路。
lines.en: I cross the grassland and the grass lies into a path.

lines.zh: 我走得很稳，像守门的兽。
lines.en: I walk like a gatekeeper beast.
Cerberumon turns toward you.
I lie down. All three heads wake.
The plains are quiet.

lines.zh: 三个头轮流守夜，从不一起睡。
lines.en: My heads take turns keeping watch and never all sleep.
My breathing is low and deep.
I keep this anchor.

lines.zh: 我不用张嘴，牙也在外面。
lines.en: I need not open my mouth to show teeth.

lines.zh: 三头的我，在等主人下令。
lines.en: Three heads, waiting on my master's word.

lines.zh: 风从诡异森林那边吹来。
lines.en: Wind from the warped wood.

lines.zh: 三个头分别看着三个方向。
lines.en: My three heads watch three directions.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在地上刨了刨。
lines.en: I paw the ground.
Hungry, and I can wait.
No other aura here.
I lift a head to the sky.
I lie lower, feigning sleep.

lines.zh: 再走一步，就进我的爪距。
lines.en: One more step and you are within my claws.
Cerberumon, an Ultimate.
I have three heads of patience.

lines.zh: 你身上的血在跳，我们听得见。
lines.en: The blood in you is pulsing; we can hear it.
Do not run. It makes me chase.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，别举起来。
lines.en: Do not raise what you hold.

lines.zh: 你抬手的样子，像是要驯服我。
lines.en: You raise a hand like a tamer.
You may try to ride.
All this grass, only us.

lines.zh: 你站的位置，正好在中间。
lines.en: You stand dead center.
My teeth can bite stone.

lines.zh: 你握武器的姿势，我三头都看见。
lines.en: All three of my heads see how you hold that weapon.
Back off and I lie down.

lines.zh: 草原尽头那棵树是我的界碑。
lines.en: The tree at the grassland's end marks my border.

lines.zh: 三个鼻子同时记住了你。
lines.en: Three noses have learned you at once.
You should not have come alone.
A piece of data breaks off.

lines.zh: 三个头分别哼了一声，很闷。
lines.en: Each of my three heads grunts, low and dull.
All three heads record you.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在草里抓了一把。
lines.en: I tear up the grass.
All three heads turn to you.
I do not cry out. I growl.
Pain excites me.
Half a step, then low again.
Your hand will be numb.
Still up. All four planted.
Data? I feed on that.

lines.zh: 肉味的来源就在你手上。
lines.en: The smell of meat comes from your hands.
Not enough for three heads.
Set it down and back off.
I smell meat.
Too hard to bite.
Keep still. I see it.
A little more and I will not chase.
Fresher data than I expected.
That feeds one head.
Not cooked.
Any more? I could eat again.

lines.zh: 你撞上我，像撞一堵皮墙。
lines.en: You hit me like a wall of hide.

lines.zh: 我的肩一顶，你退了两步。
lines.en: My shoulder pushes you back.
I shift aside, claws planted.
Not the heads.

lines.zh: 我低吼，声音从三个方向来。
lines.en: I growl from three directions.

lines.zh: 碰撞之后，草压平了一片。
lines.en: A patch of grass is flattened.
Step back so I have room.

lines.zh: 你一撞，我三头同时低了下去。
lines.en: You bump me and all three heads duck at once.
Your armor rings by my teeth.

lines.zh: 我的侧腹像一堵会呼吸的墙。
lines.en: My flank is a wall that breathes.
I am an Ultimate. Not that.
My data holds only battle.

lines.zh: 我三头一偏，都不想回答。
lines.en: All three heads turn aside, unwilling to answer.

lines.zh: 这片草原只容得下一头。
lines.en: This grass holds one of me.
Stop, or I growl.
I would rather evolve.
To ride, ask about the saddle.
I take no part in that.
I turn a head away.

lines.zh: 这话题，我用尾巴扫掉了。
lines.en: My tail sweeps it away.
I take the data in my jaws.

lines.zh: 你掉的东西，我用爪子按住。
lines.en: I pin your dropped thing.

lines.zh: 我咬着它，拖过一片草茬。
lines.en: I bite down and drag it across the stubble.
Too heavy. One head carries it.
Too small to see.
I bury it under the grass.
The meat on the ground is mine.
Keep that. I want meat.
Does this have an owner?

lines.zh: 我用爪子按住，让中间的头叼。
lines.en: I pin it with a claw and let the middle head take it.
Three heads turn to you.
I crouch and my foreclaws dig into the grass roots.
No cover on the grass.

lines.zh: 三个头都压低了，对准你的脚。
lines.en: All three heads lower and aim at your feet.
I shift from walk to run.
You backed to the warped wood.
My move is ready.
This one is World Slash.

lines.zh: 低吼从三个喉咙里传出来。
lines.en: The growl comes from three throats.
Three heads, all watching.

lines.zh: 低吼从三个喉咙里一起出来。
lines.en: A growl comes from all three throats at once.
I drop my forequarters and spring.
One circle around you, claws silent.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，草全贴在地上。
lines.en: Grass lies flat where I pass.

lines.zh: 我三头分开包，你只剩左边。
lines.en: My heads split to flank; you have only the left.
I wait for your balance to slip.

lines.zh: 草叶只在我爪下轻轻一响。
lines.en: The grass whispers once under my claws.

lines.zh: 我绕着你走，爪子压着草。
lines.en: I circle you with my claws pressing the grass.
Five paces between us.

lines.zh: 你开始出汗了，我闻得到。
lines.en: You are sweating. I smell it.
This grass is tall enough to hide me.
A little closer and you are in range.

lines.zh: 草原没有边，你也没有力气。
lines.en: No edge to the grass, no strength in you.
Three heads lower together.
World Slash crosses your chest.
My teeth bite into armor.

lines.zh: 爪子在石上刮出三道沟。
lines.en: My claws gouge three grooves.
The pounce pins you.
You are knocked two blocks.
Three heads snap together.
Heavy and blunt.
You fall back; I crouch again.
You bleed; my eyes tighten.
I hold something back.
That was a warning.
Not all three heads have bitten.

lines.zh: 草原上出现一个大影子。
lines.en: A large shape on the plains.

lines.zh: 草原上先出现三对眼睛。
lines.en: Three pairs of eyes appear over the grassland first.
Three heads lift together.

lines.zh: 你听见一声很低的低吼。
lines.en: One low growl.

lines.zh: 诡异森林那边的风变了。
lines.en: The wind from the warped wood shifts.
A guardian at the anchor.
My data takes shape.

lines.zh: 我一路走来，草向两边分开。
lines.en: Grass parts on both sides of me.
I walk to the middle of the plains.
I will hold this ground.

lines.zh: 锚点旁边，我先探出一个头。
lines.en: By my anchor, I poke out one head first.
I am there when you turn.

lines.zh: 草原的风，吹过我的三颗头。
lines.en: Savanna wind crosses my three heads.

lines.zh: 我三个头一起抬起来，你选哪个？
lines.en: Three heads rise at once; pick one.
Fire singes a patch of my hide.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下，压塌了草。
lines.en: I roll down and flatten grass.
Water to my chest. I struggle.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀到一边，三颗头都在吼。
lines.en: The blast threw me aside; all three heads roar.
All three of my heads watch you.
Arts press down my claws.
Low data. I fade.

lines.zh: 雷光里，我的三个头都亮了。
lines.en: In lightning all three heads show.

lines.zh: 脚下草原裂开，下面是空。
lines.en: The plains split to void.
